contexts.text: Or else they interpret it into evil.
But they who are in charity... interpret into good.
That they are interpreted into good. Signified.
Interpreting the sense of the Word... according to their phantasies.
The translators render Shaddai Almighty; others, Thunderer; but it properly means Tempter, and Benefactor after temptations.
For there is nothing which is not infused into principles of falsity as confirmatory... by interpreting wrongly...
Which they have hatched by a wrong interpretation from the Word.
They see and interpret all things wrongly.
Confirmations of falsity by interpretations from the sense of the letter...
They drag down all the other truths by interpretations...
By wrong interpretations they draw to favour their loves...
As this mourning can be appeased only by means of interpretations from the Word... to comfort = the interpretations which are made from the sense of the letter. Explained.
That the Word from the sense of the letter can be explicated to favour [anything] by means of interpretations...
They at once flee to interpretations; such as these...
The things which are primary for interpretation. Signified, Explained. AC 4966.

The primary things for interpretation are those things which primarily conduce to interpret the Word; and thus to understand the doctrinal things of love to God and of charity towards the neighbour which are from the Word.
(Sensuous things rejected) by the things which are primary for interpretation. Signified, Explained.
The Celestial of the Natural taught them from the primary things for interpretation. Signified, Explained.
Each one according to the interpretation of his dream () = the event which they had in themselves; (for) the interpretation of a dream = the explication, and thence the Knowledge of the event.
There is no interpreter of it () = that no one knows what is in these things. (For) an interpretation = the explication of what it has in itself.
Are not interpretations with God? () = that the Divine is in them. (For) an interpretation, when predicated of dreams, = that which is in them.
This is the interpretation thereof () = revelation from perception... of what it had in itself. Explained.
That he had interpreted good () = what would happen.
This is the interpretation thereof () = what it had in itself.
As Joseph had interpreted to them () = prediction by the Celestial in the Natural. To interpret = to say what it has in itself, or what is in it, and also what will happen, thus to predict.
The rest they interpret well.
And no one interpreting these things to Pharaoh () = that it was unknown what would happen. To interpret = to know what will happen.
Each according to the interpretation of his dream... () = what would happen to each.
And no one interprets it () = ignorance of what was in it.

Because there was an interpreter between them () = that spiritual things are then apprehended quite differently... For an interpreter translates the language of one into the language of another, thus he expounds the meaning of one to the apprehension of another...
Because (the literal sense) suffers itself to be explicated by interpretations in everyone's favour; but not the internal sense...
They admit nothing but the literal sense, which they interpret in favour of their own principles and cupidities...
Truths cannot be conjoined with evil unless they are falsified, which is done by wrong interpretations, and thus perversions. AC 9298:2.
Restoration through interpretation. Signified, Explained. AC 9032:end.
Truth can be approached by the evil, because they pervert truths by wrong interpretations...
But the translators say... AC 10570:4. AE 388:22.
He (then) confirms it from the sense of the letter... which he falsifies by a wrong application, and a perverted interpretation...
Profanation takes place when evil is applied to truth, and truth to evil, which is done by a wrong interpretation of the truth...
That this interpretation is in the natural sense... Signified.
Therefore interpretations are given elsewhere also in the natural sense, which however cannot be interiorly understood except by means of the spiritual sense...
(We looked up into Heaven) because thence we have all interpretations of the Word.
(The internal Spirits of this province) interpret all things well, even if they are not good...
I was told by an angelic interpreter that...
So that it may also be translated that... AE 714:end.
To interpret the Word as to its spiritual sense from falsities of doctrine, closes Heaven.
